Super Drag turns drag-and-drop into fast mouse gestures. Grab a link, a piece of selected text or an image, flick it in a direction, release — done.

WHAT YOU CAN DO • Links: open in a new tab (foreground or background), current tab, new window or private window; copy the link or its text; search the link text; save the link as… • Text: open it as an address if it looks like one, or search it with any of your Firefox search engines; copy, translate, or save it as a .txt file. • Images: open in a new tab, copy the image or its address, search for similar images (Google Lens, Yandex, Bing, TinEye), save the image as…

GESTURES, YOUR WAY • Separate gesture sets for links, text and images. • Up to three strokes per gesture: 4 single, 12 double and 36 triple gestures for each type. • Choose a search engine per gesture — your Firefox default or any installed engine. • Adjustable recognition threshold, from short to long flicks. • Exceptions list to turn Super Drag off on specific sites (wildcards supported).

CHANGE YOUR MIND MID-DRAG • A small pill follows the cursor and shows the action that will run. • Changed direction? If that combination has no action, the action of your last strokes is used — nothing gets lost. • Bring the cursor back to where you started to cancel. Release there and nothing happens. • On release the pill confirms the result: green ✓ when the action is accepted, grey ✕ when cancelled, red when something failed.

STAYS OUT OF YOUR WAY • Short drags and gestures with no action behave exactly like normal Firefox drag-and-drop. • Drops into text fields, editors and upload zones are left alone. • Works in private windows (after you allow it in about:addons).

PRIVACY Super Drag collects no data, has no analytics and makes no network requests of its own. Settings are stored locally in your browser. Links, text and images go only where you send them with a gesture.

Remote workers and teams
Students and professionals
People who frequently work with many tabs
Anyone looking to reduce browser distractions
Organizations that want a more focused browsing experience

Install Focus Tab in Firefox.

description.en-US: Clicking a meeting, chat or notes link often opens the desktop app, and leaves a useless browser tab behind. App Tab Cleaner closes those tabs for you a few seconds after the app takes over. HOW IT WORKS • When a tab opens, navigates to or reloads a URL matching one of your rules, a countdown starts on the toolbar button (10 seconds by default). • When it reaches zero, the tab closes. If it was the last tab in the window, a new tab opens in its place so the window stays open. • Changed your mind? Click "Keep this tab" in the popup, or navigate the tab somewhere else, and it stays open. • Tip: pin the button to your toolbar from the extensions menu to see the countdown, or turn on "Notify before closing" in the settings. WORKS OUT OF THE BOX Built-in rules recognise the "handoff" pages that popular video-meeting, chat, notes, community and project-management apps leave behind, not their normal web versions. You can edit, reorder or turn off any of them. Rules for apps whose handoff pages look identical to normal use are included but off by default. YOUR OWN RULES • Match any URL with regular expressions, with optional exceptions • Set a timeout per rule, from 0 seconds to an hour • Test patterns against a URL live in the rule editor • Drag to reorder rules; the first match wins • Pause everything with one switch • Import and export rules as JSON • Rules sync between your Firefox installs through Firefox Sync PRIVACY App Tab Cleaner collects nothing and makes no network requests. It has no host permissions, no content scripts, and never reads page content. It uses only: • tabs: to read tab URLs and close matching tabs • storage: to save your rules • alarms: to close tabs reliably after long timeouts • notifications (optional): only if you turn on "Notify before closing" Free and open source (MIT): https://github.com/babraham123/app-tab-cleaner

caption.en-US: The popup counts down before closing a leftover tab
Built-in rules for popular desktop apps
Write your own regex rules and test them live
Minimal permissions and optional notifications

summary.en-US: Automatically closes the browser tabs left behind when a link opens a desktop app, like a meeting or chat client. Regex rules, per-rule timeouts, a countdown on the toolbar icon, and no data collection.

description.en-US:
Long conversations on claude.ai are hard to find your way around. Waypoints adds a slim rail on the right edge with one mark for each message you sent, so you can jump straight to any of them.
  • Message rail: click a mark to jump to that message. Hover the rail for a list of all your messages, with the time you sent each one.
  • Send times: recorded automatically for every message you send.
  • Saved messages: bookmark any of your messages, add a note, and jump back to it later, even from another chat.
  • History: everything you've sent, across all your chats, grouped by day and searchable.
  • Keyboard shortcuts: move between your messages without scrolling. You can change them.
  • Light and dark mode: matches Claude's look.
PRIVACY Everything stays in your browser. Waypoints has no server, no analytics and no tracking, and it never sends your data anywhere. It runs only on claude.ai, never in private windows. You can export or delete your data at any time from Settings. PERMISSIONS - Access your data for claude.ai: to show the rail and panel, and to read the messages you send there. No other site. - Storage: to keep send times, saved messages and settings on your device. Good to know: messages sent before you install Waypoints, or from another device, have no send time. Waypoints is an unofficial project and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

caption.en-US: Jump to any message you sent: the rail and the list of your messages, with send times.
See when you sent each message: times are recorded automatically as you send.
Save the messages that matter: bookmark any message, add a note, jump back later.
Everything you've sent, in one place: grouped by day and searchable.
Private by design: stored only in your browser; runs only on claude.ai.

summary.en-US: Navigate your Claude chats, save messages, and keep the time you sent each one.

description.en-US: Apex Embroidery Fonts Detector is a fast, lightweight typography inspection tool built for crafters, digitizers, and web designers. Identify fonts, styling, and CSS properties of any text on any webpage instantly, or scan entire pages to summarize all active fonts. Key Features: - Instant Selection Inspect: Highlight any text on a webpage to view font family, size (px & pt), weight, line-height, letter-spacing, text color (HEX & RGB), and HTML element tag. - Full-Page Font Scanner: Open extension popup and click "Scan Page Fonts" to analyze all typography across the active tab, ranked by usage frequency. - 1-Click Copy: Click any detected font name or CSS property to copy directly to clipboard. - Clean On-Page Tooltip: Minimalist dark floating card displays full computed styles without opening browser developer tools. - 100% Privacy & Offline-First: Zero data collection. No tracking scripts, no external servers, no ads. All inspection runs strictly inside local browser sandbox. How to Use: 1. Click extension icon in toolbar and switch toggle to "On". 2. Highlight any text on any webpage to view typography details in tooltip. 3. To view all fonts on the webpage, open popup and click "Scan Page Fonts". 4. Click any value to copy to clipboard. Explore compatible machine embroidery fonts and custom designs on the official Apex Embroidery Designs catalog.

description.en-US:
Press space. Skip ten seconds. Come back tomorrow exactly where you left off. Smart Video Controls fixes the most annoying things about watching videos in Firefox — and now cleans up the ads that get in the way.
  • Dead keyboard shortcuts on streaming sites — Space, arrows, speed controls all work, even inside embedded players other extensions can't touch (cross-origin iframes).
  • Losing your place mid-episode — your position is saved automatically and restored when you return. Close the tab, come back tomorrow: you're exactly where you left off. Positions sync across your devices through your Firefox account.
  • Intrusive ads around the player — video page cleanup hides ad overlays that cover the player, closes pop-under ad tabs, and sends your tab back if a site hijacks it to an ad.
  • Works with cross-origin iframe players — reaches videos inside embedded players that other extensions can't.
  • Automatic position resume — saved per episode, restored on every return visit.
  • Keyboard shortcuts — play/pause, skip ±10s (±30s with Alt), volume, speed 0.25×–4×, fullscreen. All rebindable in the popup.
  • Video page cleanup — hides ad overlays, gates, and anti-adblock walls covering the player; closes pop-under ad tabs; restores hijacked navigations. It never clicks ads.
  • You stay in control — both cleanup features have toggles in the popup, and a per-site switch disables everything on any site.
  • Overlay cleanup and all playback features: Firefox 115+
  • Pop-under tab guard: Firefox 128+ (older versions simply skip it)
Everything runs on your device. No browsing history is collected, no ads are clicked, nothing is transmitted — except optional anonymous usage counts (opt-out in the popup) and your own synced positions. See the privacy policy linked on this listing.
  • storage — your positions and settings, on your device.
  • scripting + host access — required to reach videos inside embedded players and to clean the page around them.
  • alarms — periodic housekeeping (position sync, cleanup).

summary.en-US: Enhance your video watching experience on the Web. Auto-resume and keyboard shortcuts — even inside embedded players others can't reach.

description.vi: The Quiet Cue turns a small theater into a playable first-person stage-management game. Read the cue board, set the backdrop, light and sound, then call each act on time. Four acts form a complete performance with a score and a three-miss failure path; the set changes on the actual stage as the player works. Shift requests mouse lock, WASD moves, E operates stage controls, and 1/2/3 plus Enter provide keyboard shortcuts. Progress is saved locally inside the browser. No website permissions, account, analytics, or network connection are required.

summary.vi: Run a four-act theater performance by matching scenery, lighting, and sound cues against the clock.

description.vi: Prism Ward is a self-contained first-person light-routing puzzle. Move through a glasshouse, inspect each beam path, rotate the mirrors, select the filter, and hold a clean beam on the plant bed long enough to restore it. The three stations introduce distinct routing combinations and a wrong filter visibly scorches growth instead of giving a false success. Shift requests mouse lock; WASD moves; E operates the optical hardware. Your station progress stays in this browser's local extension storage. The game needs no account, browsing access, server, or network connection.

summary.vi: Guide sunlight through a three-bed glasshouse by rotating mirrors and choosing spectral filters.

description.vi: Ashline is a first-person field-survival game on a cooling volcanic plain. Follow three beacon-marked sample sites, route around lava pools, use cooler sample pads to recover, and return the collection to camp. Heat and health respond to your position; the camp can rapidly cool you, while prolonged exposure can end the survey. Shift requests mouse lock, WASD moves, and E takes samples or uses the camp console. Collected samples are saved locally so the expedition can be resumed. The game is offline and does not read web pages or send data anywhere.

summary.vi: Survey a volcanic field, collect three samples, manage heat, and return safely to base.

description.en-US: Proxy Exception Toggle makes managing Firefox proxy bypass exceptions quick and convenient. Right-click any browser tab and open “Proxy exceptions” to see the domains used by that tab, including domains loaded by background requests and other page resources. Each detected hostname can be toggled individually: • domain.com — match the exact hostname • a.domain.com — match a specific subdomain • .domain.com — match the domain and its subdomains The extension also avoids redundant choices: when .domain.com is already enabled, individual subdomains covered by that rule are not shown. A filled circle (●) indicates that a rule is currently enabled. An empty circle (○) indicates that it is not enabled. The extension changes Firefox's existing proxy bypass list and does not provide, replace, or modify the proxy server itself. All detected hostnames and proxy exception information are processed locally. The extension does not send browsing data to an external server.

summary.en-US: Quickly add or remove domains and subdomains from Firefox proxy bypass exceptions directly from a tab's context menu.

description.fr: Sauvegardez des offres d'emploi en un clic, remplissez vos candidatures depuis votre profil et transformez votre profil LinkedIn en CV. HiredFolio est un compagnon de recherche d'emploi qui s'intègre directement dans le panneau latéral de votre navigateur. Pas besoin de changer d'onglet : parcourez les annonces et sauvegardez-les instantanément avec les détails pré-remplis. SITES SUPPORTÉS HiredFolio fonctionne sur plusieurs sites d'emploi populaires et peut aussi détecter automatiquement les offres qui utilisent des données structurées de type JobPosting. Un réglage « Capturer sur tous les sites » vous permet d'étendre la détection à n'importe quel site, ou d'autoriser les sites un par un, à votre rythme. SAUVEGARDE EN UN CLIC Lorsque vous consultez une offre sur un site supporté, HiredFolio détecte et analyse automatiquement l'annonce. Ouvrez le panneau latéral pour voir le titre, l'entreprise, le lieu, le salaire et la description pré-remplis — il suffit de cliquer sur Sauvegarder. Aucun copier-coller nécessaire. ANALYSE INTELLIGENTE HiredFolio utilise un moteur d'analyse à trois niveaux : 1. Des analyseurs personnalisés pour chaque plateforme majeure 2. Des analyseurs configurables pour les sites additionnels 3. Un analyseur JSON-LD générique qui fonctionne sur tout site avec le balisage Schema.org JobPosting Même les sites sans support dédié sont souvent analysés automatiquement. REMPLISSAGE DE CANDIDATURE Nouveau : sur un formulaire de candidature, HiredFolio peut remplir les champs depuis votre profil et joindre le PDF de votre CV. Vous relisez chaque valeur dans le panneau latéral, puis vous envoyez vous-même sur le site. HiredFolio ne soumet jamais à votre place. SUIVI D'OBJECTIFS HEBDOMADAIRES Définissez des objectifs hebdomadaires pour les offres sauvegardées et les candidatures envoyées. La carte de progression sur votre page d'accueil vous maintient responsable et motivé tout au long de votre recherche. TOUJOURS ACCESSIBLE Le panneau latéral reste ouvert pendant votre navigation — pas de popups qui disparaissent, pas d'onglets supplémentaires. Naviguez entre les annonces et vos candidatures sauvegardées en toute fluidité. IMPORT DE VOTRE PROFIL LINKEDIN Créez un CV compatible ATS à partir de votre profil LinkedIn. Ouvrez le panneau latéral sur votre profil et lancez l'import — HiredFolio récupère votre titre, votre expérience, votre formation, vos compétences et vos certifications. Vérifiez les données capturées, retirez ce que vous ne voulez pas importer, puis ouvrez le CV généré dans l'éditeur pour le peaufiner. INTÉGRATION DU CRÉATEUR DE CV Après avoir sauvegardé une offre, créez un CV sur mesure en un clic. HiredFolio vous redirige vers le créateur de CV avec les détails de l'offre pré-chargés. VOS DONNÉES, VOTRE CONTRÔLE Toutes les données de vos candidatures sont stockées en toute sécurité dans votre compte HiredFolio. L'extension lit le contenu des pages uniquement sur les sites d'emploi supportés, ou sur les sites que vous autorisez explicitement, pour en extraire les annonces. Chaque autorisation reste révocable à tout moment dans les réglages de l'extension. Lorsque vous déclenchez le remplissage, elle lit les libellés du formulaire ; les valeurs remplies restent dans le navigateur. « Mémoriser pour ce site » enregistre un mapping et une valeur dans chrome.storage.local sur cet appareil (en clair, plafonné par origine) et peut remplacer le profil en ligne pour ce site. Un rapport optionnel peut envoyer uniquement les libellés — jamais vos réponses. Aucune donnée n'est vendue ou partagée avec des tiers. Gérez votre pipeline de candidatures complet sur hiredfolio.com — suivez les statuts, définissez des rappels, et créez des CV et lettres de motivation sur mesure pour chaque candidature.

summary.en-US: Save job postings in one click, track applications, and stay on pace with weekly goals.

description.en-US: AccuKnox Prompt Firewall protects your organization when employees use AI assistants. It inspects prompts before they are sent and responses before they are shown, applying your organization's AccuKnox Prompt Firewall security and compliance policies in real time. Supported AI assistants - ChatGPT (chatgpt.com) - Claude (claude.ai) - Google Gemini (gemini.google.com) - GitHub Copilot (github.com) - Microsoft Copilot (copilot.microsoft.com) - Microsoft 365 Copilot (m365.cloud.microsoft) Key features - Real-time prompt scanning — each message is checked against your policies before it leaves the browser. - Response scanning — AI responses are inspected before they are displayed. - Policy-driven verdicts — content is allowed, blocked, or flagged with a warning based on your firewall's response. - Enterprise-ready — settings can be centrally deployed and enforced by administrators via managed storage (MDM/Intune). How it works Enter the API key from your AccuKnox tenant. Prompt and response content is sent only to your organization's AccuKnox Prompt Firewall endpoint for a security and compliance verdict, and the extension acts on that verdict. Requirements An active AccuKnox account and API key are required. This add-on is intended for organizations using the AccuKnox security platform.

summary.en-US: Scans AI assistant prompts and responses through AccuKnox Prompt Firewall for security and compliance

description.en-US: SEO Inspector — a full on-page SEO audit of any page, in one click. Free, local, no account. Open the popup on any website and get a clean, organized breakdown of the page's SEO: what's wrong, where it is, and how to fix it. Everything runs inside your browser. What it will never do 🚫 No account, no sign-up, no paywall. There is no Pro version. Every feature is free for everyone. 🚫 No analytics, no telemetry, no trackers. Nothing is ever sent to the developer. 🚫 No permission to read every site. It works on the page you open it on (activeTab). Site access is asked only when you start a check that needs it — link checker, image checker, sitemap or hreflang validation — and you can say no. 🚫 No requests behind your back. Beyond the page you are on, it contacts a server only when you press a button; every case is listed in the privacy policy. The Domain tab sends nothing but the domain name to rdap.org / dns.google, and only when you open it. 🚫 No pop-up tabs while you work, no nag screens, no interruptions. After a feature update it opens its own changelog page once, so you can see what changed — nothing else, ever. What it does 📋 Summary — An Indexability verdict with the exact reasons: robots meta, X-Robots-Tag header, canonical, and whether robots.txt blocks Googlebot from this URL. Title and Description with character count and their real width in pixels, measured in the font Google uses, so you see what actually gets truncated. Canonical, Author, Publisher, Lang, Charset, live counts of headings, images and links, and a Google result preview. Color-coded status dots, one-click copy buttons. 🚩 Issues — Every problem from every tab in one list: critical, warnings, and quieter notices. Click any item to jump to the tab that explains it. 🏷 Headers — All H1–H6 in document order, indented and color-coded. Flags skipped levels, empty headings, a first heading that isn't H1, more or fewer than one H1, repeated headings, headings hidden from readers and headings parked off-screen. Copy the outline as Markdown, plain text, HTML tags or a spreadsheet table. 🎯 On-page highlighting — Labels every heading right on the page, and does it intelligently: slides hidden in a carousel or text folded under "read more" don't get stray labels floating in empty space — the container gets one summary chip ("H4 ×22 · 11 unique"). Labels never cover the heading they name. Switch on the link layer to see every link colored by kind — internal, external, nofollow, sponsored, UGC, anchor, empty href — with a legend; after a link check, broken links turn red and redirects amber right where they sit. The image layer outlines pictures without ALT or TITLE. 📝 Content — Word count, unique words, water, stop words, sentences and average length, Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch–Kincaid grade, Gunning Fog. Top words and 2- and 3-word phrases with frequency, density, and whether each appears in your Title, Description and H1. ⚡ Speed — Live Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB) and the whole load waterfall: DNS, TCP, TLS, request, response, DOM interactive / content loaded / complete, transfer size, request count, every resource slower than 300 ms — each with a verdict. 🌍 Hreflang — Every language alternate and the x-default check. Then the part most tools skip: press "Check alternates" and it fetches each alternate page and reads its own tags — does it link back, does it return an error, does it redirect, does its canonical point somewhere else? Google ignores a cluster whose pages don't point at each other; now you can see it. 🖼 Images — Totals without ALT and without TITLE with thumbnails, images shipped far larger than the space they fill (aware of Retina screens, so a correct 2× image is never flagged), and an on-demand check for broken and heavy files. 🔗 Links — Totals, internal vs. external, unique, nofollow, anchors, empty hrefs, links pointing at an anchor that doesn't exist. Click any number in the breakdown to open the list already filtered. The Link checker probes every link's HTTP status; filter by All / Internal / External / Nofollow / Issues and click a result to jump to that link on the page. 📣 Social — Open Graph and Twitter Card tags with image preview, exactly as social networks and messengers will render them. 🧩 Schema — JSON-LD parsed and validated against Google's rich-result rules: required and recommended fields per type. Missing fields come with a copy-paste-ready fix, added lines highlighted. If a node's url or mainEntityOfPage points at a different page — the classic copied-template mistake that makes Google attribute your markup elsewhere — you get a warning naming the field, and the exact line is highlighted in the JSON. Microdata and RDFa are detected too. 🌐 Domain — The full registrar record via RDAP (modern WHOIS): registrar, IANA ID, website, WHOIS server, abuse contact, registrant and country where not redacted, status codes, DNSSEC, and the creation, update and expiry dates. Live DNS records (A, AAAA, NS, MX, TXT) over DNS-over-HTTPS. 🛠 Tools — Which of 14 AI and search crawlers may fetch this URL under robots.txt (Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and more) with the rule that blocks each. llms.txt and llms-full.txt detection, technologies, HTTP response headers. A sitemap validator that starts from the Sitemap lines in robots.txt, follows sub-sitemaps and .gz files, reports URLs with errors or redirects, and tells you whether the page you're on is listed at all. A check of the http / https / www / bare variants of the URL — how many different addresses they end on. Shortcuts to Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, Rich Results Test, Facebook Debugger and the W3C validator. 📄 Export — Download the audit as JSON or CSV, or open a clean, printable report. 🔔 The icon speaks for itself — After a scan the toolbar icon shows the number of critical issues, a green tick when the page is clean, and a tooltip listing the problems — no click needed. Optionally (off by default, needs site access) it can count issues as soon as any page finishes loading. 🖱 Right-click menu — On a page: open it in Rich Results Test, PageSpeed Insights or the Schema validator; jump to robots.txt, the sitemap or llms.txt; run a site: search; check the page's history on Archive.org; copy the heading outline. On a link: check its HTTP status, including where a redirect lands. On selected text: find copies of it on Google, see whether it appears in the title, description and H1, or measure its length in pixels. Every item can be switched off in settings. ⚙ Settings that follow you — Interface language, theme, default tab, highlighting and menu preferences live inside the popup and sync across your computers when Firefox Sync is on. description.zh-CN: Extension Health Checker scans every extension you've installed in Firefox and tells you — in plain English — what each one can really do. One-click audit Instantly see every extension's permissions translated into everyday language: "This extension can read everything you type on any website" instead of "host_permissions: <all_urls>". A clear SAFE / CAUTION / DANGER rating for each one. 2026 risk intelligence Flags extensions that were silently upgraded from Manifest V2 (the legacy system browsers have been phasing out) — these often arrive with wider permissions than the original. Warns about extensions with the same broad permissions as known malicious ones. Safer replacements For every risky extension, the checker suggests a safer, lighter, open-source alternative that does the same job with fewer permissions. Change Monitor (Pro, one-time $4.99) Runs a weekly scan in the background. The moment a silent update adds a new dangerous permission — webRequest, proxy, cookies, debugger — you get a notification with exactly what changed. You can revert or uninstall from the popup. Pre-install scanner (Pro) Paste any extension's Add-ons URL before you click Add to Firefox. The checker pulls its declared permissions and tells you whether to trust it — before it ever touches your browser. What you get - One-click audit of every installed extension - Risk ratings with the reasoning behind them - Plain-English permission translations - Curated safer replacements - Optional weekly monitoring for new dangerous permissions - Optional pre-install scanner No account. No telemetry. Works fully offline for the core scan. One-time $4.99 unlock for the monitoring and pre-install features. Built by TingStudio. Independent project — not affiliated with Mozilla, Google, or any extension vendor.

developer_comments.zh-CN:
Permissions justification:
- management: enumerate installed extensions and read their declared permissions for the audit.
- storage: saves scan history and user settings locally. No data leaves the browser.
- alarms: schedules the weekly Change Monitor scan. Runs locally.
- notifications: alerts the user when a newly added dangerous permission is detected.
- host_permissions (ehc-license.tingstudio.workers.dev): used only for the Pro license activation/validation endpoint. No page content is read.

Re: Unsafe assignment to innerHTML (6 warnings)
All innerHTML assignments use hardcoded template strings or values passed through escapeHtml(). No unsanitized user input, extension name, URL, or remote data is ever concatenated into innerHTML.

Re: management.uninstall is not supported
The uninstall feature is optional. On Firefox, the API is unavailable; the code path is only triggered from a user-initiated button. No crash occurs.

summary.zh-CN: Audit every Firefox extension in one click. Plain-English risk scores, safer alternatives, and optional weekly monitoring for dangerous permission changes.

description.vi:
The Weight of Rain is a systems-survival game about a settlement suspended from a cliff. Water is both a necessary reserve and a moving structural load. Three bays each carry stored water, crew, and fixed ballast. The player's job is to redistribute that load and choose which drains remain open before advancing the next forecast front.

Every rain front adds a different amount of water to each bay. The resulting moment around the anchor line determines settlement tilt and structural stress. Excessive tilt or exhausted anchor integrity ends the watch. Surviving all eight fronts reaches dawn and records the remaining anchor integrity as the local best watch.

The settlement is presented as an animated architectural section rather than a conventional strategy dashboard. Tanks visibly fill, the whole structure rotates under asymmetric load, rain crosses the scene, and the anchor line remains the central visual reference.

summary.vi: Keep a cliff settlement balanced through eight storms by moving water, people, and ballast.

description.vi:
Dead Air Cartographer is a stealth exploration game in which the map exists only where sound has reached. Footsteps reveal nearby stone a few cells at a time. A deliberate signal call reveals a much larger area, including distant walls, the survey lantern, and moving returns—but it also causes listening creatures to advance toward the player.

Three complete valley cuts use different wall structures and creature placements. The player has three breaths. Contact with a moving return consumes one breath and sends the player back to the cut entrance. Reaching the lantern completes the cut while leaving unexplored territory intentionally dark.

The visual field is rendered locally with Canvas using fading echoes, sparse phosphor lines, and temporary wave fronts. The system distinguishes known terrain from unseen terrain without using a conventional permanent minimap.

summary.vi: Map a dark valley with sound while the creatures inside it listen back.

description.vi:
Borrowed Gravity is a compact spatial puzzle game set inside an axis-transfer laboratory. Each chamber contains a player, an amber power core, a core socket, an exit, and a deliberately limited arrangement of walls. Rotating the gravity vector changes which surface acts as the floor and sends every unanchored body toward that direction.

The player can lock their body anchor, move independently across the current surface, release the anchor, and rotate gravity clockwise or counter-clockwise. A chamber is complete only when the amber core reaches its socket and the player reaches the exit at the same time. Five handcrafted chambers introduce stopping surfaces, baffles, crossed axes, and increasingly constrained routes.

The game uses an isometric pseudo-3D presentation rendered locally with Canvas. Progress advances locally after each solved chamber. There are no advertisements, energy timers, purchases, accounts, or online leaderboards.

summary.vi: Rotate a chamber's gravity, move its cargo, and reach the exit without losing the power core.

It's a browser extension designed to instantly convert measurement units, currencies, colors, and time-related units directly from your current tab, giving you instant answers without getting you off-course from what you are currently doing. [ Functions ] TaoScale allows you to convert multiple parameter types:
  • Quantities: Length, Area, Mass, Volume, Temperature, Pressure, Power, Energy, Data Storage, and Speed. Useful when following foreign recipes, checking dimensions, or reading technical specifications:
  • Length: 12 cm to in

[ Powered By ] TaoScale is built for speed and accuracy, utilizing open-source libraries like convert, dayjs, chrono-node, colord, and colorjs.io. Currency rates are fetched daily using ExchangeRate-API.

主要功能

自動偵測目前頁面中的直連影片網址
一鍵使用瀏覽器原生下載功能儲存影片
選用的進階下載模式：搭配本機安裝的開源工具 yt-dlp，處理串流合併等較複雜的下載需求
可自訂下載檔名樣板，並支援換頁自動重新掃描

關於進階下載功能（Native Messaging）
進階下載模式需要你另外在自己的電腦上安裝一個小型本機程式（Native Messaging Host）以及開源工具 yt-dlp。這一步驟不會透過本擴充功能自動完成，需要使用者手動執行安裝腳本。若不安裝，一般（基本）下載功能仍可正常使用。

使用範圍與限制
本擴充功能不會、也無法繞過任何網站的 DRM 或授權保護機制，僅能取得頁面原本就以明文方式暴露的直連影片網址。請只用於下載你擁有版權、或明確標示公開授權（如 Creative Commons）的影片內容，並請遵守各網站的服務條款。多數主流影音平台（YouTube、Netflix、Facebook 等）的服務條款明確禁止未經授權下載其內容，本工具不建議也不鼓勵用於此類用途。

關於權限使用

<all_urls> / activeTab：讓偵測功能能在任意你造訪的頁面中運作
downloads：呼叫瀏覽器原生下載 API 儲存檔案
storage：僅在本機儲存你的個人設定（如檔名樣板）
webNavigation：偵測換頁以清除舊的影片偵測快取，避免顯示錯誤分頁的結果
nativeMessaging：僅用於與使用者自行安裝的本機進階下載程式通訊，資料不會傳送到開發者或任何第三方伺服器

Staring at a screen all day tires your eyes. The 20-20-20 rule is a simple habit that helps: every 20 minutes, look at something about 20 feet away for 20 seconds.

20-20-20 Lookaway keeps time for you, quietly, from the Firefox toolbar.

How it works

Click the stopwatch to start. The icon becomes a countdown of the minutes until your next break, switching to seconds in the final minute.
When time's up, a gentle beep tells you to look away. The icon turns blue for the break.
After 20 seconds a second beep tells you to look back, and the cycle starts again.

Controls

Click: start, or pause and resume (the icon turns amber while paused)
Double-click: stop
Right-click: open 20-20-20 Settings

Settings

Work time in minutes (default 20)
Look-away time in seconds (default 20)
Beep volume
Beep sound: soft chime, bell, two-tone, wood block or digital, with a test button
Restore defaults

description.vi:
Open Until is an event-based household ledger for items whose useful life changes after opening. Each item has a category, storage state, remaining quantity, and chronological event strip. Opening, chilling, freezing, thawing, a warm gap, an observed change, and partial use all update the item record and its ordering in the use queue.

The central label shows an estimated remaining window and a plain status such as steady, use next, or review now. Items are sorted by current priority so an overlooked carton, jar, produce bundle, cosmetic, or dry good becomes visible without searching a spreadsheet. A restock sample demonstrates the complete interaction model.

Open Until does not claim to determine food, cosmetic, or household-product safety. Its estimates are organizational prompts based on category and recorded handling events. Users must use product instructions, official safety guidance, and their own observation when deciding whether an item is suitable to use.

summary.vi: Track household items by opening, storage, observation, and use—not only a printed date.

description.vi:
Margin Weather is a local probability workspace for plans whose task durations are not known exactly. Instead of asking for one optimistic date and presenting it as certainty, the extension records a best case, likely case, and difficult case for every task. It then runs 2,400 seeded simulations, respects task dependencies, and shows an empirical completion distribution.

The forecast reports the median, P80, P90, and P95 completion horizons, the probability of finishing before the chosen deadline, and the task contributing most strongly to the schedule tail. A release-front sample is included so the model can be understood before entering a real plan. Tasks can be added, edited, linked to a predecessor, removed, and re-simulated at any time.

Margin Weather is intentionally a decision aid rather than a promise. It does not connect to calendars, project systems, or external services. All task data and the last forecast are stored in the extension's local browser storage area and remain on the device.

summary.vi: Turn uncertain task durations into a probability forecast for the whole plan.

description.vi:
Faultbook is a local incident-reconstruction workbench. It separates what was expected, what signal was observed, what assumption was held, what decision was made, and what outcome followed. The sequence stays visible as a horizontal evidence strip while the selected event can be corrected or expanded.

A second view builds a control ladder across elimination, prevention, detection, limitation, recovery, and reminders. Faultbook audits whether an incident has meaningful detection and recovery coverage, whether assumptions were recorded, and whether signals were connected to decisions. The resulting coverage score is a prompt for a stronger system, not a score for a person.

An included package incident demonstrates how an apparently reasonable release decision can expose missing controls. A self-contained HTML report can be exported for a review meeting or local archive. Faultbook contains no collaboration backend and sends no incident information anywhere.

summary.vi: Reconstruct incidents as decisions, signals, assumptions, and controls without reducing them to blame.
